sci.evolution.fossils-and-extinction.L5.4: A rock with shells of sea animals in it, from the time of the dinosaurs. A sea covered that land then.

sci.evolution.human-origins.L5.1: In a museum, look for stone hand axes made long ago.
sci.evolution.human-origins.L5.2: A stone hand axe in a museum picture. People made hand axes about 1.5 million years ago. No bones were found with them, so nobody knows which kind of human made them.
sci.evolution.human-origins.L5.3: The top of an ancient human skull, found in 1982 on a river bank, in a museum picture.
